description: This file contains unit tests for ECDSA cryptographic operations using the BoringSSL/OpenSSL library, including signature creation, verification, handling of different curves, and test vectors.

classes.name: ECDSA_SIG
classes.description: Structure representing an ECDSA signature with r and s components.

methods.name: HexToBIGNUM
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a BIGNUM wrapped in a UniquePtr.

methods.name: NewSecp160r1Group
methods.description: Creates a new EC_GROUP object for the secp160r1 curve with specific parameters.

methods.name: VerifyECDSASig
methods.description: Verifies an ECDSA signature using specified API (encoded or raw).

methods.name: TestTamperedSig
methods.description: Modifies a valid signature to test verification failure on tampering.

methods.name: GetCurve
methods.description: Retrieves an EC_GROUP based on test vector attributes.

methods.name: MakeCustomClone
methods.description: Creates a clone of an EC_GROUP with the same parameters.

methods.name: GetBIGNUM
methods.description: Retrieves a BIGNUM from test vector data.
